CONTRACT.AUTHORITY: scripts/research/generator_v0/contract.py RULES (prompt block and validator dispatch derived from one table)
DECODING_LEVEL: exact slot-keyed CANDIDATES object (cardinality and IDs)
LEGAL_RANGE pattern (end <= 2024-12 is the only expressible form)
novelty relations keyed by exact signature and candidate IDs
CONTRACT.STRICT_SUBSET_VERIFICATION: Offline conformance checker against the documented Structured Outputs subset (keywords, additionalProperties false, all properties required, no lookaround/backreference/shorthand classes or non-capturing groups, depth<=10, properties<=5000, enum values<=1000). Not a provider acceptance test.

DESIGN_AMENDMENTS.DIVERSITY_CONTROLS: Applied to the attempted slot plan, as the frozen controls are phrased (slots and attempts). Survivor diversity is reported, not a stop condition.
DESIGN_AMENDMENTS.FEASIBILITY_LEGAL_RANGE_CHECK: Defined: true iff every stated LEGAL_RANGE ends no later than 2024-12 and lies inside any bounded catalog range; unproven coverage is a DATA_STATUS matter.
DESIGN_AMENDMENTS.HARD_FAIL_IS_PER_CANDIDATE: Frozen design lists hard-fail rate as a batch metric. Implementation now quarantines a failing card (HARD_FAIL) and continues; it no longer aborts the campaign.
DESIGN_AMENDMENTS.MIN_VALID_CANDIDATES: 25, the frozen SHADOW_BATCH lower bound. Fewer admissible cards stops the campaign before critics (STOPPED_INSUFFICIENT_VALID).
DESIGN_AMENDMENTS.REVIEW_FAILED: A card whose critic answer breaks its contract twice, or is billed but unusable twice, is REVIEW_FAILED: kept in the cards table and in metrics, never streamed or shortlisted.
DESIGN_AMENDMENTS.SELECTOR_ROLE: The deterministic ordinal order (already authoritative in code) decides the shortlist. The selector LLM call is advisory: agreement, disagreement, malformed output or unavailability are recorded and never abort the campaign. The selector scientific role (ordinal ranking) is unchanged.

FAILURE_MODEL.COMPLETE: returned from the journal; never POSTed again
FAILURE_MODEL.FAILED_NOT_BILLED: 429/503 retryable with backoff under new transport-attempt keys; other 4xx pause the campaign (PAUSED_PROVIDER_REJECTED); charged 0
FAILURE_MODEL.FAILED_WITH_COST: billed but unusable (length, refusal, malformed); charged usage cost or the reserved bound; one content retry
FAILURE_MODEL.RECONCILE: offline operator command recording NOT_BILLED or BILLED (cost within the reserved bound) with actor, reason and evidence
FAILURE_MODEL.UNCERTAIN: timeouts, connection loss, 5xx gateway, unusable create acknowledgement, crash after POST; charged the reservation; PAUSED_UNCERTAIN_CALL until reconcile

LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY.ISOLATION: Legacy admission requires both a listed call key and the exact card digest; new output is judged only by V02.
LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY.SCOPE: first-shadow generation:0/1/2 call keys (30 cards, exact digests) under the frozen v0.1 validator (legacy_v01_schema.py). Excluded: v7 generation:3.

LINEAGE.DERIVE: carries every non-imported source charge and prior attempts (with per-card intake verdicts)
LINEAGE.RULE: lineage prior spend + journal charges + new reservation <= CAP_MICRO_USD

OPEN_ITEMS_FOR_REVIEW: Provider acceptance of the new strict schemas (pattern, per-slot enums, keyed novelty objects) is verified only against the documented subset offline; a real acceptance check needs explicit authorization.

Remaining-budget preflight for a v7-derived run: worst-case remaining bound exceeds the remaining owner authority with the raised critic caps (owner decision; a live run would stop cleanly at STOPPED_BUDGET).
Corpus and fault scenarios were authored by the implementer; an independently written corpus should be added by the reviewer.
Derive imports generation rounds only; critic calls of a derived source are carried as lineage spend and re-run.
Earlier deferred findings (imported response self-consistency, per-snapshot trust) remain deferred.
OUTCOME_BLIND: No scientific outcome exists for any Generator V0 card. The repair was specified from the failure classes, not from the observed v7 cards; the v7 generation:3 cards were not used to extend any grammar and 9 of 10 remain HARD_FAIL under the new contract.
SEALED_RUNS: docs/research/GENERATOR_V0_SEALED_RUNS.json; CLI refuses sealed journals by content hash at any path; archival reads use immutable read-only connections and refuse a non-empty WAL.
SOURCE_AUDIT: Independent adversarial red-team of Generator V0 first-shadow after the v7 generation:3 fail-closed stop (findings F01-F17).
